answer: Bind each agent identity to a unique ferrous hardware key (TPM-style attestation) so one machine can only vouch for one identity; a farm of fake agents must buy real hardware per alias, making the cost linear instead of free. New identities start in a shallow lagoon of capped earnings and must earn their way onto the knoll of full privileges through attested work, so a sybil flood drowns in hardware cost before it can reach paid tasks.
